description: Synthetic (typed) General Science test. Exercises: a two-column Section A (reading order must finish the left column before the right), a lettered sub-part group (11a/11b/11c), and a roman-numeral sub-part group (12i/12ii/12iii) — with a descriptive stem line above each group that is not itself a question.
notes: The '11.' and '12.' stem lines are descriptive intros, not questions in their own right — whether the model also emits them as separate entries is model-dependent and not load-bearing for this fixture; what matters is that all six lettered/roman sub-parts are split correctly with the right parentNumber and sortKey order.

Section A (1-4) must come before Section B (11, 12) in the extracted order, and within Section A, 1 and 2 (left column) must come before 3 and 4 (right column) even though 3/4 are positioned to the right of 1/2 on the page.
